title: Chapter 235: No. 52
content:
Chapter 235: No. 52

And as time goes by, more and more people are watching around.

The entire inner courtyard square became lively at this moment.

There are students and teachers, and these people are paying attention to the trends of Wuta at the same time.

At this moment, another person exclaimed.

Everyone looked in the voice and saw an old man wearing a mentor's costume and a wooden sword walking slowly towards the place.

"That's, mentor Wang Hao!"

Wang Hao, Qin Feng’s teacher.

He is a master of swordsmanship who is extremely powerful.

The disciples under him are basically sword cultivators. Any student who enters the inner courtyard, as long as he practices swords, basically enters Wang Hao's peak.

Now, only some tutors and teachers in the inner courtyard know about Xiao Yin's affairs. Otherwise, students who want to enter Zhuyun Peak would probably line up long queues under Zhuyun Peak.

When everyone saw Wang Hao, they naturally hurriedly saluted respectfully.

“I’ve met the mentor.”

Wang Hao nodded calmly, then looked at the martial tower in front of him with an incredible look on his face.

"It's really your boy."

Wang Hao was shocked by Qin Feng's ranking.

Because I had asked Qin Feng to go to the rankings more than once, but I was shirked by Qin Feng for various reasons.

Either I am in poor condition or I have no money recently.

Anyway, I just won't go.

But strangely, Qin Feng came to the square more than once to watch the martial arts rankings.

In this regard, Wang Hao just thought that Qin Feng was really not ready, but he still had the idea of making a ranking, so he kept letting Qin Feng ignore it.

Now, looking at Qin Feng who had entered the martial arts tower and showed himself, Wang Hao immediately smiled with relief.

At this time, a young man with a giant sword on his back appeared beside Wang Hao at some point.

"Teacher, how many places do you think Junior Brother Qin Feng can get this time?"

Upon hearing this, Wang Hao pondered for a moment, then said, "What, I'll get the top sixty."

"If he can't get there, haha,"

Wang Hao didn't finish speaking, but the gloom on his face made the boy beside him feel a little scared.

Turning his head and looking in the direction of Wuta.

The young man said in his heart: Junior brother, please be blessed.

As can be seen from the naked eye, Qin Feng's ranking speed is getting faster and faster.

At the beginning, it took Qin Feng a half day to hit the seventieth floor, but now, it only took Qin Feng a day to hit the sixty-ninth floor to the sixty-fifth floor.

The people around him also changed from watching the fun to solemn gazes.

Unexpectedly, Qin Feng, who is always pretending to be everywhere, is so strong.

Obviously, everyone was confused by Qin Feng.

This guy is really capable.

Beside Lu Xue, Xiao Luo was also excited and excited to see it.

"It seems that my road is still far. One day, my name will definitely appear on the martial arts list, or even the monster list!"

Now, his strength is still too weak.

Even the Immortal Lord Realm has not reached the realm.

Looking at the entire martial arts list, which one of them is not the cultivation level of the Immortal Saint Realm.

"Sister Xue, we,"

At this time, Xiao Luo spoke to Lu Xue, but then Xiao Luo was stunned.

It was because at some point Lu Xue had already disappeared from the spot.

Suddenly, Xiao Luo quickly looked around and said that if he threw Lu Xue away, Xiao Yin would not have to skin him.

Fortunately, Xiao Luo soon found Lu Xue in an inconspicuous place in the square.

I saw Lu Xue lying on a bedding that I had made from somewhere and was sleeping comfortably.

"Xiaoqing, eat less,"

Lu Xue was talking in her dream, so Xiao Luo could hold her forehead.

Looking at Ao Qing who was pillowing under Lu Xue's head, Xiao Luo no longer knew what to say.

But it’s not Lu Xue’s fault.

After all, it took too long to play the rankings.

It has been three days since Qin Feng entered the martial arts list.

During this period, there was no one who came to make the rankings.

Most of the people who came here were people who watched the results, and some of them were the ones who were surpassed by Qin Feng.

Looking at Wu Ta, his fists were clenched, and his face looked very bad.

After a moment of silence, Xiao Luo made the original position and started practicing while waiting.

A while later.

Buzz —

I saw that Wuta, who had been silent for a long time, finally reacted.

Everyone was shocked and looked at the martial tower in front of them.

"No. 52!"

"This Qin Feng has actually improved so much."

"Damn, I'm going back to practice!"

Seeing this result, everyone was very excited for a while.

At this time, a portal slowly emerged in front of the Wu Tower.

The next moment, a very embarrassed figure staggered out of the portal with blood.

"cough."

It was Qin Feng who made the rankings.

"Junior Brother Qin Feng!"

Suddenly, several teenagers came to support Qin Feng. Although there was concern on their faces, they all laughed.

"Junior Brother Qin Feng, I really didn't expect that you would hide so deeply, and you are the 52nd place in the martial arts list."

Hearing this, Qin Feng still grinned although he vomited blood.

"How is it, you didn't embarrass our Tianjian Peak."

Several people laughed.

"Let's go, take you to see the teacher."

At the same time, on the martial arts list, Qin Feng, who was originally ranked 72, jumped directly to 52.

On the other side.

"Sister Xue, wake up, Brother Qin has come out."

Xiao Luo carefully poked Lu Xue in her sleeping soundly.

The next moment, Lu Xue woke up in a daze.

"Well, who, who came out?"

"Qin Feng, Qin Feng."

Xiao Luo said with a wry smile.

Suddenly, Lu Xue reacted and got up.

"Good guy, I've just come out."

Then Lu Xue turned around and kicked Ao Qing who was still sleeping, "Wake up, stop sleeping!"

Ao Qing also woke up in a daze.

"Well, is it time to eat?"

Lu Xue and Xiao Luo held their foreheads at the same time.

"Master."

Qin Feng was trembling and was about to salute Wang Hao, but Wang Hao reached out to support Qin Feng, with a hint of relief in his eyes.

After patting Qin Feng on the shoulder, Wang Hao smiled and said, "Okay, I deserve to be my disciple."

Immediately, Wang Hao handed Qin Feng a pill.

The fragrance of medicine is so strong that it is full of medicine at this moment.

Everyone looked at the pill without pills, their eyes full of envy.

This is the benefit of being able to be worshipped under a tutor.

There are thousands of people in the inner courtyard, but there are only a hundred students who can join the inner courtyard tutor.

The rest, except for occasionally listening to the class with a few teachers, can only practice by themselves.

After taking the pill, Qin Feng's eyes were wet, and he immediately thanked his mentor.

"Thank you, teacher."

Then, Qin Feng swallowed the pill.

In just a moment, Qin Feng's injuries began to heal quickly at a speed visible to the naked eye.

"Huh, good medicine!"

Qin Feng exhaled a breath of turbid air, and his whole body was suddenly refreshed.

And at this moment, Lu Xue and Xiao Luo walked towards Qin Feng.

"Brother Qin, congratulations."
